# NPPLOT

Another name for PPLOT.

## Syntax

```text
NPPLOT [VARIABLES=] varlist [/subcommands of PPLOT].
```

The same command as PPLOT, with the same subcommands and defaults.

## Example

```text
NPPLOT battery_hours /DISTRIBUTION=WEIBULL /FRACTION=VW.
```

`statscraft help NPPLOT` prints the same text in the terminal. [All commands](README.md)
